_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Acquisition Strategy Plan
summary: The Acquisition Strategy Plan gives the government detailed insight into the contractor's plan for procuring items, data, or services to meet contract requirements throughout the acquisition lifecycle.
use_relationship: The Acquisition Strategy Plan (ASP) provides the government with detailed insight into the contractor's plan for procuring the necessary items, data, or services from subcontractors and vendors to meet contract requirements. It describes the comprehensive strategy for the entire acquisition lifecycle. This plan enables government oversight to ensure the acquisition process is efficient, competitive, compliant with regulations (e.g., FAR/DFARS), and effectively manages risk.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format:
preparation_instructions.content: The Acquisition Strategy Plan shall be in the Government, unless specified otherwise in the Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL). In Microsoft Word, New Times Roman, 12 point font.

preparation_instructions.title: Content:
preparation_instructions.content: The ASP shall detail the contractor's comprehensive approach for managing acquisitions and include the following elements:

children.title: Executive Summary:
children.content: A concise overview of the acquisition need, the proposed strategy, and key business and contractual considerations.

children.title: Market Research:
children.content: A summary of the market research conducted to identify potential sources, assess market capabilities, and determine the commerciality of the required items or services.

children.title: Acquisition Approach:
children.content: A description of the planned acquisition method. This shall include the rationale for the chosen approach (e.g., competitive vs. sole-source), the proposed contract type (e.g., Firm-Fixed-Price, Cost-Plus), and any special contracting considerations.

children.title: Source Selection Strategy:
children.content: The plan for evaluating proposals and selecting a source. This section shall describe the evaluation factors and their relative importance (e.g., technical, price, past performance).

children.title: Risk Assessment:
children.content: An analysis of potential acquisition risks (e.g., schedule delays, cost overruns, technical performance issues) and the corresponding mitigation strategies.

children.title: Government Furnished Information/Property (GFI/GFP):
children.content: A description of any GFI or GFP required to support the acquisition and the plan for managing it.

children.title: Acquisition Milestones:
children.content: A schedule of key acquisition activities and milestones, from the finalization of requirements to contract award and delivery.
